name: Coronado (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of dark green, white and dark green, the white charged with a yellow crown between the words CORONADO and THE CROWN CITY.
history: Coronado (Spanish for "Crowned") is a beach city in San Diego County, California, United States, across San Diego Bay from downtown San Diego. The flag was adopted on 3 April 1922 (approved by the city council by Resolution No. 715, according to Flags of the World).
